summary: Backend-only regression + targeted verification of the close-block email fix (send_email no longer raises; close_block always returns 200 + email_sent/email_error). New targeted suite /app/backend/tests/test_close_email_fix.py (5 tests) + full existing suite /app/backend/tests/test_quota_backend.py (18 tests). Final run: 23 passed, 1 skipped (transient Resend rate-limit on happy path for resend-email). All 6 features/bugs listed in the review request are verified. The critical bug is CONFIRMED FIXED: POST /api/blocks/{id}/close returns 200 with email_sent=false and email_error containing the Resend 'Undeliverable recipient'/'Rate limited' message when the email fails, the block becomes status='closed' and the bonifico is persisted. The old HTTP 502 propagation to the frontend is gone. GET /api/blocks/{id} after a failed-email close correctly shows status='closed' and bonifico present. resend-email still returns 502 with JSON detail on Resend failure (acceptable per the spec, since it's an explicit retry, not a block closure). No code changes to product; only test file edits.
action_items: No action needed on the targeted fix — it is working as specified. The frontend close.tsx behavior (showing 'Blocco chiuso, email non inviata' with the server error) is implicitly validated by the backend contract: body always contains {ok:true, email_sent:bool, email_error:str|null}.
Pre-existing /settings route 401 handling red-screen (reported in iteration_3) is still outstanding — unrelated to this iteration's fix.
critical_code_review_comments: send_email() correctly returns {ok,error,id} and never raises; _assert_safe_email ValueError is also caught into {ok:false,error}. Good.
close_block() sets status='closed' + closed_at + bonifico unconditionally and only toggles email_sent_at / email_error based on email_res['ok']. Good.
resend_email_block() still raises HTTPException(502, detail=email_res['error']) — intentional per spec (explicit retry, not a block closure). Good.

Minor: close_block does not persist email_sent_at=None when a previous attempt had set it (edge case: close succeeded in email once, somehow called again — but second close is blocked by the 'Blocco già chiuso' 400 guard, so not reachable).

Minor: EmailStr validation on PUT /config rejects .local TLDs (special-use), so the review-request's example 'foo@invalid-domain-test.local' cannot be used via the API; tests use direct Mongo patch to set an undeliverable-but-syntactically-valid email (foo@invalid-domain-test.com). This is a test-infra note, not a product bug.
No MongoDB _id leaks in any tested response (users, blocks, config).

success_rate.backend: 100% (23/23 passed, 1 skipped due to Resend rate-limit)

seed_data_creation: Mongo seed in /app/backend/tests/test_close_email_fix.py module-scope fixture: users.user_id='user_close_email_test', users.email='test@quota.local', user_sessions.session_token='test_close_email_token' (7-day expiry). Teardown deletes users+sessions+configs+blocks for that user_id. Full-suite also seeds user_id='user_test' from the pre-existing /app/backend/tests/test_quota_backend.py and tears it down.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL = https://co-parent-expenses-3.preview.emergentagent.com. BASE_URL is read from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Two separate test modules each manage their own seed/teardown. The Resend proxy (integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send) rate-limits aggressive runs (HTTP 429); tests tolerate this via skip/rate-check branches. If re-running soon after a heavy burst, wait >60s or expect the delivered@resend.dev happy-path tests to skip. For a strict 'both success and failure email paths' validation on close_block, test 1 (foo@invalid-domain-test.com → email_sent=false) and test 2 (delivered@resend.dev → email_sent=true OR rate-limited) together prove the fix independent of email outcome.
rca_of_issue: RCA (VERIFIED FIX): send_email() used to raise HTTPException(502) when Resend returned 4xx/5xx (e.g., 422 'Undeliverable recipient' for test TLDs or 429 rate-limit). close_block propagated that exception, aborting the DB write and losing the user's bonifico input — client saw 'HTTP 502' with no block closure. Fix in /app/backend/server.py: send_email now returns {ok:bool,error:str|None,id:str|None} without raising; close_block sets status='closed'+bonifico unconditionally and only decides between setting email_sent_at vs email_error based on email_res['ok']; response body always includes email_sent and email_error so the frontend (close.tsx) can show a clear 'Blocco chiuso, email non inviata' alert instead of a generic 502. Verified by: (1) POST close with parent2_email='foo@invalid-domain-test.com' → 200, email_sent=false, email_error contains 'Recipient looks undeliverable...' or 'Rate limited'/'email rate limit exceeded', block.status='closed'; (2) POST close with parent2_email='delivered@resend.dev' → 200, email_sent=true (or rate-limited false), block.status='closed'; (3) GET block after both cases shows status='closed' with bonifico persisted; (4) POST close on already-closed block still returns 400 (idempotency guard intact); (5) POST resend-email still returns 502 with JSON {detail: <Resend message>} on failure — unchanged on purpose, acceptable for an explicit retry endpoint.
